One of the most common struggles when trying to build muscle or lose weight is figuring out how to get enough protein throughout the day. The 150g shown in this video is just an example — it’s not a target that everyone needs to hit. Your individual protein needs depend on factors like body weight, activity level, and goals.

The foods shown here are examples of protein sources, not complete daily meal plans. Your actual meals should also include vegetables, fruit, carbohydrates, and other foods based on your individual needs.

冰箱裡總有優格，但我以前一直搭錯東西。
光吃益生菌其實只做到一半。那些活菌需要好的纖維才能在腸道好好存活，大多數人買了優格，卻忘了放那些真正能餵養它們的食物。
這次我買了五樣簡單東西：有機藜麥八寶米（家裡的白飯我直接換成這個）、大燕麥片、冷凍莓果、綜合堅果，最後是一大桶無糖希臘優格。前四樣就是專門在餵最後那桶優格裡的好菌。
半夜想吃甜的，我就挖一勺優格拌莓果，放冷凍庫30分鐘，吃起來像軟冰淇淋，糖分卻少很多。

My fridge is always stocked with yogurt, but I used to pair it all wrong.
Eating probiotics alone is only half the story. Those live cultures actually need the right fiber to survive and thrive in your gut. A lot of us grab the yogurt but forget the stuff that feeds them.
This grocery run I brought home five simple things: organic quinoa multi-grain rice (I swapped out my regular white rice for this), rolled oats, frozen berries, mixed nuts, and a big tub of plain Greek yogurt. The first four are there to support the good bacteria in that yogurt.
Late-night sugar craving hits? I scoop some yogurt, mix in berries, and stick it in the freezer for 30 minutes. Comes out tasting like soft-serve ice cream but with way less sugar.

少吃多動還是瘦不下來，後來才發現問題根本不在那裡。

是腸道菌 🦠（英文叫 microbiome）。你腸道裡的菌越多樣，身體就不容易發炎，也比較好瘦。我自己開始認真照顧腸道後，真的差超多。

Honestly, I was stuck for so long — eating less, moving more, and still not losing weight. Turns out the problem wasn’t there at all.

It’s your gut bacteria 🦠 (the microbiome). The more diverse it is, the less inflammation you have, and the easier it is to lose fat. Once I started actually taking care of my gut, the difference was huge.

Caring for it really comes down to three things: eat more fiber, add some fermented foods (kimchi, yogurt, whatever works), and try to get 30 different plants a week. It’s easier than it sounds.

This is part one of “Understanding Your Gut” — in part two I’ll show you foods that can mimic the effects of the weight-loss jab, so follow along so you don’t miss it.

我以前每天早上都直接空腹喝咖啡，什麼都沒吃。 結果十點多就開始莫名其妙地餓，一直想吃東西，明明才喝完咖啡不久。後來才發現，問題不是咖啡，而是我沒先吃東西。

早上起床皮質醇本來就高，空腹喝咖啡又把它再往上推，身體會馬上發出「我需要能量」的警報。 那種餓其實不是真的餓，是荷爾蒙的關係。

解決方式超簡單： 先吃點東西或等一下時間再喝咖啡，無論是黑咖啡還是拿鐵都一樣。

我現在早上起床都會先喝溫水，再吃一碗希臘優格 + 堅果 + 幾顆莓果，五分鐘搞定，蛋白質和纖維先墊底，再慢慢喝咖啡，整個早上狀態差超多，會穩定很多。
真的試過就回不去了！
傳給每天早上空腹喝咖啡的朋友～ 👇

I used to drink coffee on an empty stomach every single morning.
Wake up, immediately go for the coffee, zero food. Then around 10am I’d get this random hunger and keep wanting to snack.
Turns out it wasn’t the coffee’s fault. It was because I hadn’t eaten anything first.
Your cortisol is already high when you wake up, and drinking coffee on an empty stomach pushes it even higher. Your body starts panicking and sending “I need energy NOW” signals. That hunger isn’t real, it’s just hormones.
Super simple fix: Eat first, then drink your coffee.
I do Greek yogurt + nuts + a few berries. Takes 5 minutes. Protein and fiber go in first, then I enjoy my coffee. The whole morning feels way more stable.
Once you try it, you won’t go back.
Send this to your friend who drinks coffee on an empty stomach every day 👇

體重沒掉，不一定代表你沒進步。
很多時候，身體已經開始變小、線條變清楚、飢餓感變穩，只是體重計還沒反應過來。

不要只被一天的體重數字影響心情。
真正該看的，是你的週平均、腰圍、衣服鬆緊，還有你能不能穩定做到不暴食、不亂餓。

減脂不是每天都會掉秤，但只要方向對，身體會慢慢給你訊號。

Weight not dropping doesn’t always mean nothing is happening.
Sometimes your body is already getting smaller, your shape is changing, and your hunger feels more stable — even before the scale catches up.

Don’t let one morning’s number control your mood.
Look at your weekly average, waist measurement, how your clothes fit, and whether you can stay consistent without bingeing or starving.

Fat loss doesn’t show up on the scale every single day, but your body will usually give you signs when you’re moving in the right direction.

You are not addicted to sugar. You might just be exhausted and under-fed.

Your cravings are rarely a lack of discipline. Most of the time, they are just a signal.
Before you blame yourself tonight, check the basics:
1 Did you actually eat enough food today?
2 Did you get enough protein?
3 Did you sleep well last night?
Sometimes the craving isn’t the problem you need to fix. It is just your body asking for better support.

Sleeping 8 hours but still waking up exhausted?

The problem isn’t the quantity—it’s the quality. Your body can’t recover if it never hits deep sleep. Fix your rest tonight with these 3 actionable steps:
Digital Detox: No screens 30 mins before bed to stop blue light from overstimulating your brain.
Fast for Sleep: Stop eating 3 hours before bed so your body focuses on repair, not digestion.
Smart Supplementation: Use Magnesium Glycinate to relax your muscles and stabilize your nervous system.
